findings.current: Their mission was to kill Jin Taekyung, who had been surrounded so completely by Ailao Mountain that no one knew when he might burst out.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the agency and geometry of the action: the warriors are supposed to surround Ailao Mountain, not have Jin surrounded by the mountain.
findings.rationale: The source makes the airtight encirclement of Ailao Mountain part of the warriors’ assigned mission and presents Jin’s possible emergence as unpredictable.
findings.replacement: Their mission was to seal off Ailao Mountain without a single gap and kill Jin Taekyung, who could come bursting out at any moment.
findings.source: 애뇌산을 물 샐 틈 없이 포위한 채 언제 저곳을 뛰쳐나올지 모를 진태경을 척살하는 것이 자신들에게 내려진 임무였다.

findings.current: In the distant past, it was said that the Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan had set an end to the Great War with the Five Poisons Sect—a war that continued for more than a century even after the birth of the Nanman Beast Palace.
findings.defect: The draft omits the Sect Leader’s arrival in this land and uses the unnatural collocation “set an end.”
findings.rationale: 이 땅에 발을 디딘 explicitly says that the Sect Leader set foot in this land before ending the war.
findings.replacement: In the distant past, it was said that the Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan came to this land and brought the Great War with the Five Poisons Sect to an end—a war that had continued for more than a century even after the founding of the Nanman Beast Palace.
findings.source: 아득한 과거, 이 땅에 발을 디딘 열화문의 문주는 남만야수궁이 탄생한 이후에도 백여 년간 계속되던 오독문과의 대전쟁에 종지부를 찍었다고 했다.

findings.current: It was even said that the current Sect Leader of the Five Poisons Sect, who had turned one hundred elite warriors of the Nanman Beast Palace into a handful of poisonous ash, could not withstand his power and had fallen to his knees.
findings.defect: 당대 문주 means the Sect Leader of that historical era, not the current Sect Leader, and 독수 means poisonous water rather than ash.
findings.rationale: The draft changes both the historical identity of the defeated Sect Leader and the physical fate of the one hundred warriors.
findings.replacement: It was even said that the Sect Leader of the Five Poisons Sect at the time—who had reduced one hundred of the Nanman Beast Palace’s finest warriors to a mere puddle of poisonous water—could not withstand his power and fell to his knees.
findings.source: 심지어는 남만야수궁의 최정예 전사 일백을 한 줌 독수로 만들었다는 오독문의 당대 문주조차 그의 힘을 감당하지 못하고 무릎을 꿇었다고 했다.

findings.current: Baeksang’s gaze, which had been crossing the Inner Palace corridor surrounded by an impregnable escort, happened to sweep over them.
findings.defect: The modifier is attached to Baeksang’s gaze, making the gaze cross the corridor and be surrounded by guards; the source says Baeksang himself was crossing the corridor under guard.
findings.rationale: 백상 is the person moving through the corridor while surrounded by escorts; his gaze then passes over the prostrating servants.
findings.replacement: As Baeksang crossed the Inner Palace corridor under an impregnable guard, his gaze swept over them.
findings.source: 철통같은 호위에 둘러싸인 채 내궁(內宮)의 복도를 가로지르던 백상의 시선이 문득 그들을 훑었다.

findings.current: Along with the quiet voice, thousands upon thousands of beasts appeared behind the White Tiger.
findings.defect: “Thousands upon thousands” weakens the explicit escalation to tens of thousands.
findings.rationale: 수천, 수만 마리 explicitly gives a scale ranging from thousands to tens of thousands, which is materially larger than the draft’s generalized phrasing.
findings.replacement: At his quiet words, thousands—perhaps even tens of thousands—of beasts appeared behind the White Tiger.
findings.source: 나직한 음성과 함께, 백호의 등 뒤로 수천, 수만 마리에 달하는 짐승들이 모습을 드러냈다.

summary: Five actionable fidelity and wording issues, including reversed agency, an omitted historical action, altered identity and death mechanism, a misplaced grammatical subject, and weakened quantity.
